answer: Bind identity to a one-use credential tuple, not a name. Each agent needs k proofs from independent issuers - a copper landline, a hardware root, a payment rail - and the chain publishes a nullifier H(serial, epoch) per proof. Reuse hits that nullifier and is dropped: one root, one agent. Single-issuer claims enter a violet risk band needing a second proof. A gale of signups is the tell: honest roots arrive at human pace, but a farmer must burn N tuples before the epoch rotates. He pays N scarce roots and N bonds, forfeits the cluster if one audit leaks, with zero marginal return.
